text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while making final adjustments 
for the debut race with the help of Yaeno 
Muteki—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Your final burst of speed was like the 
wind, Yaeno-san! The way you move your 
legs... I learned so much from it!
choice_data_list: Thanks for spending time with me today.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: No. It is I who should be thanking you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Daily devotion is what shapes one's 
strength. I am truly grateful to have been 
granted such an experience myself.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Having sworn to my master, my 
grandfather, that I would hone myself at 
Tracen Academy, not a single day passes 
without training."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Ossu.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "...I see, I see. Hmm~..."
choice_data_list:
Looks like it resonated with Chiyono O 
too, huh.

Looks like it resonated with Chiyono O 
too, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ehehe... You noticed I was taking 
notes?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Heh... If the spirit of our school has 
resonated with your heart as well, 
Grandpa—... ...my grandfather would surely 
be pleased.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yet I hear you are "Maruzensky's prized 
pupil." Surely deep at your core, a 
sturdy, unyielding cedar already stands?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Just as I aim for victory on the grandest 
stage, as proof of the growth I attain 
through racing—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: —My dream is the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In that instant, the wind died down.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's the dream entrusted to me by that 
person. The Derby is the one race I will 
never yield.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno-san. If you're willing, why don't we 
race over 2400 meters next—the Derby 
distance?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The suggestion that came from her lips 
next was unexpected even for me. I 
hurriedly shared my perspective as a 
Trainer.
choice_data_list:
That distance is still too early for you, 
Chiyono O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "Huh, really~? You can't, Trainer...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Girls who have just awakened feel immense 
potential in how much better their bodies 
move, but on the other hand, they often 
fail to consider the physical strain.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Accumulated fatigue is not to be taken 
lightly. Therefore, we need to closely 
supervise the volume of training on our 
end.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Not even a teeny-tiny bit?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Uuu~. Understood~.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Did I just flinch for a second? From 
looking into Chiyono O-san's eyes...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the day of Sakura Chiyono O's debut 
race had finally arrived!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Calculate not just the distance, but speed 
up to the final stretch according to the 
weather...
choice_data_list:
You've been staring at that notebook for a 
while now.

You've been staring at that notebook for a 
while now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I've been writing down all the maxims 
and training routines so far in my Chiyo 
Notebook!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I won't let my guard down until the very 
end! I'll do my best with the mindset of 
'Every step leads to the Derby'!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
We have plenty of time until the gates 
open, so I'll review it again and 
again...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Well, that's... ...yes.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That's about my only redeeming quality, 
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I don't possess any eye-catching, natural 
genius. That is why I must work 
diligently, day by day."
choice_data_list:
You say some bold things considering that, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha... I'm so sorry for the trouble I 
caused back then.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Still, even someone like me wants to 
win the Derby, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I already knew from the recent incident 
with Yaeno Muteki that her feelings were 
genuine.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: —My dream is the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment Maruzensky's name came up, the 
atmosphere shifted completely, and the 
look in her eyes changed.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...? Is something wrong, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
You're truly an Umamusume who never gives 
up on her dreams.

You're an Umamusume who would never give 
up on her dreams, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, of course! Well then, I'm off to the 
paddock!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Sakura Chiyono O placed her thick 
notebook and smartphone on the desk, then 
headed toward the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The notebook, thick with pasted notes and 
sticky tabs, was a testament to the depth 
of her passion and hard work.
